home.heading: Isaac
home.lead: I'm interested in health, the brain, computers, and solving problems. I [write](/writing.html) longer form [articles](/site.html#articles) as well as some shorter [posts](/site.html#posts) about what I find out, and I keep a [now page](/now/) of what I'm doing at the moment. Some recent [projects](/site.html#projects) of mine are [transferfil.es](https://transferfil.es), [bioenergetic.live](https://bioenergetic.live/) and [fourpots.com](https://fourpots.com/). I also keep [bookmarks](/bookmarks.html) and a list of the [tools I use](/uses.html), you can also visit my [full site](/site.html), or you can [email me](mailto:mail@isaacmp.xyz).

bookmarks.heading: Bookmarks
bookmarks.intro: Things I've read, watched, enjoyed, and saved — I keep them here so people can see what I've liked, and so that I can go back to them anytime. It's also a way to reduce the number of tabs cluttering my browser.
